design.paletteSource: Exact six-digit tokens from pasted HTML; semantic scopes reconciled below

scopeRules.voiceOrb: voice orb, waveform and listening only
scopeRules.media: existing media/CDE material and confirmation accents; not a new gold theme
scopeRules.error: actual error, blocked/destructive state only; ordinary Stop uses neutral/focus styling
scopeRules.mint: people/domain token is distinct from voiceOrb

glass.selectedTreatment: rim and focus, not a 0.90 opaque body

layout.units: CSS pixels; tuples [x,y,width,height] relative to full workspace viewport
layout.placement: Measure visible rects and projected sphere bounds on resize, content change, keyboard and dock movement; collapse to tabs/sheet if exclusion constraints fail.
layout.keyboard: Use visualViewport and safe-area insets; recompute available region, never overlap or crop controls.
layout.expandedConversation: Occupies the managed panel slot; collapsed voice dock remains, no independent stacking.
layout.mediaFullView: Temporarily minimize nonessential panels and restore exact prior state on close.

scene.domainCoordinates: Use actual loaded Object3D/store positions for rendering, labels, agent targets and snapshot. No display-only alternate coordinates.
scene.radius: Use canonical active-project radius. Pasted source=6.2; ZIP earlier=8.2. Do not silently mix them.
scene.interiorCompositing: Render transparent interior to an appropriate render target if physical transmission does not sample it; do not assume opacity fixes it.
scene.resources: Dispose replaced geometry/material/render targets; seed procedural positions; mutate materials in place where possible.
scene.domainCreation: Explicit request only; stable UUIDs, parent-relative layout and sphere bounding-volume collision checks; duplicate focuses matching domain.

camera.opticsConvention: 24mm vertical gate equivalent; horizontal field depends on viewport aspect. Do not call every aspect ratio 36x24mm.
camera.fit: Project bounds into sceneSafe, solve distance and off-axis composition at chosen lens. Never keep overview distance when changing to 85mm.
camera.path: Arc-length sampled path; interpolate target and orientation; smooth quintic time profile; explicit arrival receipt.
camera.singleOwner: User input, tour and voice arbitrate one camera controller; cancel obsolete commands.

postProcessing.threeRevision: Use installed/locked revision and matching addons; do not mix r128 CDN with r186 modules.
postProcessing.passContract: Linear scene -> selective bloom -> subtle grade -> single tone map -> neutral-media composite in defined display-linear domain -> grain/vignette with masks -> single output transfer. Document exact chosen pass color domains.

runtimeManifest.privacy: Send whitelisted UI metadata only, no raw DOM, secrets, protected records or document instructions.

dispatch.aliases: Preserve old tool names only as tested adapters to the same new handlers.
dispatch.successRule: Handler invoked AND expected observed state reached; a log line is not completion.
dispatch.llmMutationPolicy: Allowlisted action JSON only; no arbitrary selectors, scripts, HTML, API calls, secrets or privilege changes.

tour.source: current mounted capability registry plus authored narrative intent
tour.defaultStart: current screen; start-from-beginning only on explicit request or no active context
tour.speech: Brief natural explanation of current content, no static historical numbers. Direct navigation silent unless context is needed.
tour.interrupt: Cancel current speech, queued cues and active camera movement; preserve tour position, answer user request, resume on clear continue intent.
tour.safeTour: No send, approve, purchase, create external record, microphone/camera permission or privilege elevation. Demonstrate risky controls without invoking them.
tour.coverage: 18 existing screen identities remain scope; unavailable screens are blocked/skipped with reasons, never counted passed.

voice.provider: Existing authorized ElevenLabs conversation, do not substitute another agent
voice.toolArguments: Preserve typed named JSON; never Object.values().join().
voice.context: Implement actual contextual_update frames or installed SDK sendContextualUpdate; serialized UI displayed in a panel is insufficient.

timing.source: actual audio alignment matched to scheduled audible playback

voice.audio: Read conversation metadata and actual output format; do not hardcode 16000Hz; use one playback clock and one narration owner.
voice.fallback: Explicit Browser Voice/local mode only; never simultaneously with ElevenLabs and never labelled live provider.
voice.stop: Abort tour, active camera, cue queue and current output; reject late cancelled audio/callbacks; separate disconnect from Stop.
voice.configuration: Prepare versioned prompt/tools/KB amendment for the resolved serving agent; no automatic production publication.

gallery.integration: Port mathematical/shader behavior into existing Three.js renderer unless active app already uses R3F. No iframe or second context.
gallery.openFlow: project -> media tube -> focused item -> fullview -> exact tube pose -> project
gallery.documentReadMode: No deformed text, bloom, grain or continuous media movement; accessible DOM text/search companion permitted.
gallery.videoSource: Verified decodable URLs with CORS/auth; page links to YouTube/Vimeo are not native VideoTexture URLs.
gallery.sphereShell: Hide/dim enclosing shell for tube mode; do not squeeze infinite tube rows into a closed sphere.
gallery.agentGrounding: Only describe retrieved metadata, extracted document text, captions or authorized analysis; visible thumbnails alone do not supply semantic understanding.

screens.title: Gate and loader
screens.policy: Show only if session needs it; skipping animation never grants access.

screens.title: Arrival and voice
screens.policy: Greeting once; microphone only after explicit user activation.

screens.title: Morning briefing
screens.policy: Read actual current data; no hard-coded meeting counts.

screens.title: Portfolio
screens.policy: Uncapped data-backed list; no invented project count.

screens.title: Project workspace and media tube
screens.policy: Keep all nine existing project tabs. Add tube/fullview substates, not a separate app.

screens.title: Tasks
screens.policy: Four columns when they fit; two plus deliberate horizontal navigation on phone.

screens.title: Insights
screens.policy: Six categories retained; counts derived from actual records.

screens.title: Gmail
screens.policy: Tour demonstrates navigation only. Send requires exact separate confirmed operation.

screens.title: Calendar
screens.policy: No event creation during autoplay; derive dates from current clock and timezone.

screens.title: Drive files
screens.policy: Use authorized sources, real thumbnails and provider metadata.

screens.title: Document full view
screens.policy: Real PDF page texture; office files require supported conversion/provider path.

screens.title: Video and showreels
screens.policy: Preserve Media identity. Never claim playback from a text label.

screens.title: People and RACI
screens.policy: Owner-only data stays server-protected; presentation mode is not authentication.

screens.title: Crew workspace
screens.policy: No fake streaming text; any execution with cost requires authorized scope.

screens.title: Baghira and Kinzo
screens.policy: Two panes only when layout permits; otherwise tabs, never overlap.

screens.title: Settings and hands
screens.policy: Do not enable camera or microphone automatically; sound buttons are not hand tracking.

screens.title: CDE and story
screens.policy: Coordinates and chapter count come from the actual scene and content registries.

screens.title: Domains and return
screens.policy: No automatic spawn. Create only following the user’s explicit domain request.

securityAndEvidence.auth: Server-authorized sessions; exposed demo keypad is not access control; no owner elevation from client params.
securityAndEvidence.externalWrites: Separate explicit confirmation bound to action, payload fingerprint and authenticated user; silence cancels.
securityAndEvidence.confirmPolicy: Preserve approved timing or add explicit rearm/accessibility extension; never auto-confirm.
securityAndEvidence.undoPolicy: Cancellation before provider dispatch is not undo after send; show only the actual guarantee.
securityAndEvidence.counts: Never approvalCount * 2 = verified; computed test and source receipts only.
securityAndEvidence.storage: Only claim save after write succeeds and readback; label local-only. Never store keys, privilege or protected provider data in localStorage.
securityAndEvidence.htmlSafety: Escape user text, use textContent/React interpolation; no raw user strings in innerHTML.
securityAndEvidence.snapshot: Persist camera, selected project, panel layout, media position and versioned UI state; restore must not replay tools or external writes.

performance.adaptive: Reduce postprocessing resolution and particles before readable content or core interactions.
